Time basis: 0x40d448 calls thunk 0x4083f4 (IAT 0x620fd0 → kernel32.GetLocalTime) and passes only hour/minute/second/ms to EncodeTime 0x40d0e0 / TryEncodeTime 0x40d070, returning a Double fraction of the local day (Single 0x40d0dc = 86400000, cell b07d28ae…; integer ms 0..D−1, maximum (D−1)/D). Distinct from the DateTime Now routine 0x40d47c. Conditional [S/I], assuming a fixed stamp, the admitted Time domain and no other reset of +0x499: every tick returns early until a Time value exceeds the stamp by at least 3.5e-7 day (≈ 30.24 ms). A stamp ≤ D−32 ms is admissible by a later Time of stamp + 31 ms or more (stamp D−32 at the maximal Time); for a stamp in D−31..D−1 (23:59:59.969..23:59:59.999) no Time value passes the gate, so no Time-only recovery is inferred without another stamp reset. Arithmetic over the known predicate and Time encoding only; other +0x499 writers are not exhaustively proven (RX-TIMER-GATING) and no runtime/scheduling claim is made.

Radio-private random stream; every Randomize site requires a supplied uint32; no host clock, ambient random source or default seed; ledger bounded at 256 events, profile builds aggregated. Ordering claims restricted to this ported core (P3 not proved).
Binary64 for Extended, Math.fround for Single, roundNearestEven for Round/FISTP, Math.trunc, signed Frac, Math.exp; Extended cells projected to nearest binary64; no x87 parity.

Every refusal is an atomic [W] bounded web admission limit; none claims a native error, dialog, exception or loop outcome. Per-kind basis (RADIO-RECEIVER-SIGNAL.md): static support only for profile-active-count at N = 0 (wrap loops 0x563047..0x563061 never end) and integral-boundary at exactly z = +5 (index-101 read); native-sourced options-missing (error path 0x572441, aftermath not ported) and close-refused (close query 0x5727e8 literals, message box not shown); native outcome not established for poisson-mean-domain (the small branch may return 0), thermal-domain (binary64 limits only; Extended exp does not overflow at 700, the 1e-6 floor guards binary64 cancellation), beam-not-prepared and profile-period (unknown FPU control word; native initial σ not established); web type/resource limits for options-domain, random-budget, poisson-numeric, randomize-seed-required, clock-required and sample-shift-domain; receiver-unavailable where the native control is disabled (RC-REC-09), no direct-callback guard claimed. Poisson admission is the existing helper's mean ≥ 0, finite, ≤ 1e6.

Gates where the native UI disables the control: Add and horizontal step while the main timer runs; Mode while a stop is pending and the timer still runs; after the finish a new Receive is admitted and clears the stale +0x42d.

Source buffer record null until the first full copy; name clear kept as primaryName '' on the stale record; receivers hold only an attached flag to the single buffer (alias), no copies; no buffer contents defaulted from the catalog.
Fields not written by a ported path are null (no native initial value claimed); profile constructor zeroes only +4/+8/+0x12/+0x1c/+0x26.

JD is supplied by the caller from the radio clock scenario (WEB-PP-CLK-01 policy). Timer and Receive 'now' is a separate caller-supplied stand-in for Time 0x40d448 (local time-of-day fraction, not Now 0x40d47c), used as given: no wrapping, host or monotonic clock selection or cadence. A native-like replay supplies local day fractions and inherits the backward/midnight gate; a caller supplying a monotonic day scalar instead takes an explicit web deviation with no native authority. An unset +0x499 admits the first tick; audio, recording and 0x5b584c+5 are false.

Near-5 edge: z = 5 − 2^-50 (4.999999999999999) gives binary64 (z + 5)·10 = 100, so the accepted lookup helper refuses it as integral-boundary; 5 − 2^-49 is admitted (area ≈ 0.5). A web binary64 projection edge one ulp wide, distinct from the exact +5 native hazard; whether native reaches the index-101 read for such inputs (Extended evaluation, the lookup's own conversion) is not established.

Coupling refusal: when a coupling rebuild hits poisson-mean-domain, every tick refuses atomically; Stop is accepted but cannot reach the sweep finish; Mode, Add and the horizontal step stay refused. Closing the main receiver recovers (slots, profile and timer cleared; buffer and random stream kept), regression-tested. A reassociation miss or restoring the old buffer name are inferred exits from the existing name-compare and in-source contracts, not separately tested. Approved bounded choice, not a newly alleged native defect; an abort/recovery policy is a prerequisite before any UI.
